test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 06 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
Out of the following five figures, four are alike in some manner and one differs from these in that manner. Select the odd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6693666145f9f1e7163a55ce77217a5da486c28cfd1c0bb3ee1a28dd588195d5.png]
solution:
Logic : In each figure there is only one element or one circle is enclosed in the given figure.

So,

 
• Option - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c53fbed685bfea01c15a34bdbf1eff7504d85872a24d75446da656d022c1e5b.png] ⇒ Only one element or circle is enclosed in the given figure.

 
• Option - (2) :

** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44ec9fd9b21556c15f8993f24b7ad8530a83deb648c776cefebbb442b15a2674.png] **⇒ Here two elements or circles are enclosed in the given figure.**

 
• Option - (3) : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d900904b3bbdf7151ddca664b064172725b24e05837515d74d9f6e16011ff80.png] ⇒ Only one element or circle is enclosed in the given figure.

 
• Option - (4) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d8243806f4dd1df680526f3ab966070966b17c2aed70db752d0b0e398205939.png] ⇒ Only one element or circle is enclosed in the given figure.

Here, Figure - (2) is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
